PlanStreet is a comprehensive case management platform created to help agencies modernize service delivery, streamline workflows, and ensure accountability in mission-critical programs. With access to real-time data, intelligent automation, and seamless integrations, PlanStreet greatly reduces administrative tasks while improving transparency and performance. 

Transforming Federal Case Management:
✔ Case Management Services – Centralized, secure case handling for improved service coordination.
✔ Incident Management – Real-time tracking, risk assessment, and resolution for critical incidents.
✔ Investigation Management – Comprehensive tools for audits, compliance, and case integrity.
✔ Grants Management – End-to-end grant lifecycle tracking with built-in compliance safeguards.
✔ Referral Management – Seamless collaboration and secure data sharing across agencies.

PlanStreet is purpose-built for the unique challenges of federal agencies, offering scalability, security, and compliance with federal regulations. Whether managing social services, healthcare programs, or regulatory oversight, PlanStreet empowers agencies, putting them in control to maximize impact, drive efficiency, and deliver better outcomes for the communities they serve.
